MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  REGULAR MEETING
  JUNE 20, 2024
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  1:00 P.M.

 MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Uhring called the meeting to order at 1:00 pm.

 ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Steve Uhring; Mayor Pro Tem Doug Stewart; and Councilmembers
  Paul Grisanti, Marianne Riggins, and Bruce Silverstein (arrived at 1:10 p.m.)

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Steve McClary, City Manager;
  Kelsey Pettij ohn, City Clerk; and Parker Davis, Media Technician

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  City Manager McClary led the Pledge of Allegiance.

 REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  City Clerk Pettij ohn reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on June
  18, 2024.

 APPROVAL OF AGENDA

 MOTION  Mayor Pro Tem Stewart moved, and Councilmember Riggins seconded a motion
  to approve the agenda. The motion carried 4-0, Councilmember Silverstein absent.

V ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

 MOTION  Mayor Pro Tem Stewart moved, and Councilmember Grisanti seconded a motion
  to approve the Consent Calendar. The motion carried 4-0, Councilmember
  Silverstein absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:
  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1.  Resolution Extending the Declaration of the Existence of a Local
  Emergency Regarding Conditions on Pacific Coast Highway (PCH)
  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-36 extending the
  declaration of the existence of a local emergency related to the increase of
  reckless and illegal driving on Pacific Coast Highway and directing staff to
   Malibu City Council

  coordinate efforts with other governmental agencies to increase attention
  and create programs to reduce the risk and danger associated with paciflc
  coast highway in the City.

PUBLIC COMMENTON CLOSED SESSION

  Mayor Uhring opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: None.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

  At 1:02 p.m., the Council recessed to Closed Session to discuss the following items listed
  on the Closed Session agenda:

Personnel Matters pursuant t0 Government Code Section 54957:

  1.  Public Employee Performance Evaluation
  Title: City Manager

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  Interim City Attorney Rusin reported that the meeting convened at 1:00 p.m., after which
  time the City Council recessed to a Closed Session pursuant to Government Code Section
  54957, with all Councilmembers present, Councilmember Silverstein arrived at 1:10 p.m.
  He stated the Council discussed the items on the Closed Session agenda and took no
  reportable action.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Uhring adjourned the meeting at 1:41 p.m.

  Approved and adopted by the City Council of the
  City of Malibu on August 12, 2024.

  DOUG @mWART, Mayor
